predictor.notes: Best-supported predictor for integer quantities 1..1000, in GBP pence. The model has a minimum-price plateau, a linear regime, and an 11% discount on that linear formula starting at 377. Validated against 180 distinct exact observations with zero cent errors, including approvals at 50 and 200, both adjacent transition pairs (148/149 and 376/377), and all 100 cent-rounding phases of the final regime. All 92 additional queries after fixing the model matched. Interval fitting supports three segments; no quadratic terms are needed. Conditional on these affine regimes, the rounding constraints determine the integer-cent predictions throughout the domain, although real-valued coefficients are not uniquely identified. Unsampled localized exceptions or other departures from this model cannot be ruled out from finite observations.
